name: BambooHR
description_en:
BambooHR is a cloud HR platform built around employee records, hiring, onboarding, leave and reporting. Its Core, Pro and Elite packages add different levels of performance, employee experience and compensation capabilities; payroll and time tracking are separately priced additions.

The useful starting point is a governed employee record: staff changes, documents, approvals and reports can share the same data. Buyers should distinguish basic benefits and time-off tracking from benefits administration and time-and-attendance products, and check the US-only scope of payroll and benefits administration.
description_zh:
BambooHR 是围绕员工档案、招聘、入职、休假和报表构建的云端 HR 平台。Core、Pro、Elite 套餐分别提供不同层级的绩效、员工体验及薪酬管理功能；工资处理和工时追踪另行收费。

评估时可从权限明确的员工档案出发，让人员变更、文档、审批和报表使用同一份数据。需要区分基础福利及休假记录与福利管理、工时考勤产品，并确认工资处理和福利管理仅适用于美国员工的范围。

core_features.explanation_en: Contact details, job history, benefits and documents share a central record with access limited by role.
core_features.explanation_zh: 联系方式、任职历史、福利及文件集中记录，并按角色限制访问。

core_features.explanation_en: Customizable routes support requests such as leave, promotions and policy acknowledgments.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可配置的审批路径支持休假、晋升、政策确认等请求。

core_features.explanation_en: Reporting is part of Core, while Elite adds compensation planning and more advanced dashboards and benchmarks.
core_features.explanation_zh: Core 包含报表；Elite 增加薪酬规划、更高级的看板及基准数据。

pricing.summary_en: Paid Core, Pro and Elite; headcount-dependent fees, small-employer flat amounts and optional add-ons. Cards and FAQ differ for Core/Pro; obtain a quote.
pricing.summary_zh: Core、Pro、Elite 收费，按人数或小企业固定总额计费，附加产品另计。Core/Pro 的价格卡与 FAQ 数值不同，需报价确认。

sources.title: Smarter HR Data & Reporting Solutions | BambooHR
sources.research_notes_en: Read record contents, role controls, workflow examples, reporting and AI document-selection conditions.

sources.title: BambooHR Plans and Pricing
sources.research_notes_en: Read tier matrix, open-job limits, US-only add-ons and conflicting card/FAQ rates, including small-employer flat prices.

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.en: A practical evaluation could follow an employee moving to another location: update the employee record, route the relevant approval, then check the location in an HR report. This is an illustrative acceptance case, not an executed test. The documented record includes contact information, job history, benefits and documents. Role-based access applies on web and mobile, so the test should include what the employee, manager and HR administrator can each see. A central record is useful only after ownership of imported fields and update permissions has been agreed.
sections.zh: 可以用员工调换办公地点来评估：更新档案、发起相关审批，再检查 HR 报表中的地点。这是验收示例，并非已执行测试。官方说明档案包含联系方式、任职历史、福利及文档，网页和移动端均按角色控制访问。因此应分别检查员工、经理和 HR 管理员能看到什么。导入字段的维护责任和修改权限明确后，集中档案才有实际价值。

sections.title_en: Choose the package by the process
sections.en: Core covers employee records, workflow approvals, reports, hiring and onboarding, time off and benefits tracking. Pro adds performance reviews, 360 feedback, one-on-ones and further employee experience tools. Elite adds compensation planning, salary bands and benchmarking. The pricing comparison lists 5, 25 and 50 open jobs respectively for the applicant tracking system. A team hiring occasionally should evaluate those limits rather than assume the highest plan is necessary. Reporting-page references to dashboards and benchmarks should be checked against the purchased tier.
sections.zh: Core 包含员工档案、流程审批、报表、招聘入职、休假及福利记录。Pro 增加绩效评估、360 度反馈、一对一沟通及更多员工体验工具；Elite 增加薪酬规划、薪资区间和基准对比。价格对照表列出招聘系统同时开放职位上限分别为 5、25、50 个。偶尔招聘的团队应按这些上限评估，无需直接假定必须购买最高档。数据页提到的看板和基准功能也需要与实际购买档位核对。

sections.title_en: Separate HR tracking from paid add-ons
sections.title_zh: 区分 HR 记录与收费附加产品
sections.en: Time-off tracking does not establish that paid time-and-attendance capture is included. Benefits tracking similarly differs from Benefits Administration. Payroll and Benefits Administration are offered for US employees only; global employment is a separate offering powered by Remote. A company with staff in two countries should map each country and task to an actual service before consolidating systems. The advertised 15% payroll-and-benefits bundle discount is US-only and is not a discount on every module or every employee worldwide.
sections.zh: 休假记录不代表已包含收费的工时考勤采集；福利记录也不等于 Benefits Administration 福利管理服务。Payroll 和 Benefits Administration 仅面向美国员工；全球雇佣是由 Remote 提供支持的独立服务。跨两国雇佣的公司应先把每个国家和任务对应到实际服务，再整合系统。宣传中的工资与福利组合优惠为 15%，仅适用于美国，不能扩展成所有模块或全球员工均适用的折扣。

sections.en: The cards display Core at $10 USD, Pro at $17 and Elite at $25 per employee per month. The same page’s FAQ gives starting rates of $10.25, $17.50 and $25 for organizations with more than 25 employees. For 25 or fewer, it lists flat monthly amounts of $250, $425 and $650. These are different presentations, not a basis for a universal per-person calculation. Volume discounts, nonprofit discounts, add-ons and month-to-month versus extended terms can change the quote; annual payment options are mentioned. Obtain a written headcount-specific quote before using a budget figure.
sections.zh: 价格卡显示 Core 每员工每月 10 美元、Pro 17 美元、Elite 25 美元。同页 FAQ 对超过 25 名员工的组织列出的起价却为 10.25、17.50、25 美元；25 人及以下则列出每月固定总额 250、425、650 美元。这些展示存在差异，不能据此套用统一的人均计算。人数折扣、非营利组织折扣、附加产品、按月或延长期限合同均可能影响报价，页面也提到年度付款选项。用于预算前应取得对应人数的书面报价。

sections.title_en: Prepare records, permissions and a recovery case
sections.title_zh: 准备档案、权限和纠错场景
sections.en: BambooHR is most relevant when HR needs a shared record and repeatable approval process. A business seeking only a local payroll engine should first verify country coverage and the added cost. Before rollout, reconcile employee identifiers, reporting lines, leave balances and document access; then test an incorrect change and the route for correcting it without exposing confidential fields. Ask BambooHR is described as answering from administrator-selected documents, but the pricing table distinguishes basic AI from company-document capability in Pro. AI answer quality, connectors, import behavior, recovery procedures, hosting arrangements and export completeness were not tested. No open-source license was established from these pages.
sections.zh: 当 HR 需要共享档案和可重复的审批流程时，BambooHR 比较值得评估。仅寻找本地工资引擎的企业应先确认国家覆盖及附加费用。上线前需对齐员工编号、汇报关系、休假余额和文档权限，再测试一次错误修改及其纠正路径，确保敏感字段不会因此暴露。官方称 Ask BambooHR 从管理员选定的文档作答，但价格表区分基础 AI 和 Pro 的公司文档能力。此研究未测试 AI 回答、连接器、导入行为、恢复流程、托管安排及导出完整性，所读页面也未确立开源许可。

content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: No account workflow, payroll run, import, export or integration was executed.
research_gaps.zh: 未执行账户流程、工资处理、导入导出或集成。

research_gaps.en: The applicable contract, regional data hosting, complete export and correction history were not verified.
research_gaps.zh: 未核实适用合同、区域托管、完整导出及纠错历史。
